caption: AI Agent Tool Use Information
description: The AI Agent Tool Use Information object provides detail pertaining to the AI Agent Activity: Tool Use event type.
name: ai_agent_tool_use_info

ai_tool_input.description: Describes the input provided to the tool by the AI agent.

ai_tool_response.description: Describes the response received by the AI agent from the tool. This attribute is not available when is_pre_occurrence is true.

is_pre_occurrence.description: true indicates that the tool has not yet been invoked. false indicates that the tool use has occurred.

name.description: The name of the invoked tool, e.g. Bash, apply-patch, mcp__jira__search, etc.
